text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD#INC-2026 fired — model-catalog config mismatch for model 'moss-13b-v1'. Deployed revision: rev-2026b, expected catalog default: rev-2025f. Tokenizer version mismatch detected; inference errors and 500s for some routes.

maria: acked PD and jumping in. seeing ~12% 500 rate on /v1/generate for customers on dedicated pools.

pd-bot: PD incident acknowledged by maria at 1967002470. Escalation policy: oncall -> eng-sre -> eng-runtime.

leo: oncall here. banging on logs now. which deploy pipeline pushed rev-2026b?

samir: it was a catalog promotion earlier this morning — auto-promote job picked the wrong artifact label. Looks like the tokenizer metadata in the revision points to tokenizer v2, but the compiled artifacts are v1.

jess: copying important bits for triage: customers seeing broken tokenization leading to misaligned logits -> decode crashes. example error in inference logs: `ValueError: token id out of range` repeated across shards.

maria: impact: 3 paying customers on dedicated pools experiencing degraded output and 2 hitting timeouts. No data exfil reported. Severity P1 per SLOs.

ops-runner: can we stop the rollout or pin routes to previous revision while we investigate?

samir: yes, recommendation: temporarily pin traffic for model:moss-13b-v1 to rev-2025f and disable auto-promote. Doing a quick dry-run of the rollback command now.

maria: Please paste the exact command we can run in prod to pin.

samir: runbook command: 
```
# pin model to previous revision
redwoodctl catalog pin --model moss-13b-v1 --revision rev-2025f --reason "emergency rollback - tokenizer mismatch"
```
I also propose toggling catalog.auto_promote=false for the model until we finish root cause.

oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance window blocked? No. Proceeding with immediate pin requires approval from eng-sre lead.

leo: granting emergency approval in-channel. maria, proceed when ready. :white_check_mark:

maria: executing pin now.

incident-bot: action: catalog.pin initiated by maria at 1967002485. Job ID: job-7892.

maria: job-7892 completed successfully. Traffic shifted back to rev-2025f. Monitoring for 5m.

pd-bot: PD incident status: mitigated (partial) at 1967002491 — rollback in place. Awaiting verification before close.

jess: confirm customer reachout plan? I'll draft a short heads-up for affected customers: root cause, immediate mitigation (pinned revision), ETA for full fix. katie-cs can you prep templates?

katie-cs: on it. I'll include notes about potential transient regenerated outputs and recommended retries.

leo: still digging on why auto-promote picked the bad artifact. preliminary cause: build metadata tags are ambiguous when both tokenizer artifacts bear similar labels. I'll open a follow-up JIRA to tighten validation.

samir: also observed that the catalog validation path didn't run tokenizer-compatibility checks when promotion was manual/auto depending on tag parity. Adding a pre-promote validation step to CI.

maria: verifying metrics: 500s dropped from 12% -> 0.6% in 4 minutes. Latency back to baseline for pinned customers.

ops-runner: can we add a temporary alert to watch for token-id errors specifically across dedicated pools?

leo: created a temporary metric alert: catalog.token_errors > 5/m for any dedicated_pool. Link: https://observability/redwood/alerts/3901 (internal).

oncall-bot: escalation resumed? No further escalation needed; eng-sre looped.

maria: handing off to leo for deep dive and remediation. I'll update PD and notify affected customer leads to expect a follow-up postmortem.

pd-bot: PD note: incident moved to "post-mitigation". PagerDuty on-call remains notified for follow-up checks.

leo: I'll own the RCA and the remediation ticket. immediate action items: 1) tighten promotion validation (tokenizer check), 2) add catalog preflight comparing tokenizer hash to compiled artifact, 3) revert auto-promote until safety gates added.

samir: I'll open the PR for the validation check and add unit tests to catch tokenizer/version mismatches.

jess: CS will send initial customer comms within 60m. katie-cs to review.

maria: thanks everyone. leaving a short summary for the next on-call window: pinned moss-13b-v1 to rev-2025f at 1967002485 to stop token errors; partial mitigation confirmed; RCA/PRs assigned to leo and samir; customer comms in progress.

katie-cs: drafted message ready, will attach to PD and send after legal sign-off.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for active mitigation at 1967002524. Next steps: RCA ticket RED-842, follow-up postmortem scheduled. :memo:

leo: quick note for postmortem — include timeline of catalog promotions, CI tag parity, and a checklist for promotion validation.

maria: leaving channel, ping if something regresses. :wave:

jess: thanks team, nice quick triage.

samir: adding logs and repro steps to RED-842 now.

katie-cs: sending comms to impacted customers now.

oncall-bot: handoff to next on-call in 45m.
